title: campylospermum obtusifolium var. perseifolium

The plant has been used in traditional medicine, providing various health benefits such as treating fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Campylospermum obtusifolium var. perseifolium include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
